harnessLossExcluded: Earlier runs used a loopback-only server policy, counted client-session Revoke controls as pairing links, or clicked an ambiguous Revoke label.

classification.policy: No state, weight, threshold, or bad-sample filter changed. No pairing credential is retained in the report or screenshots.
